pages.main_text_excerpt:
Experience, expertise and commitment
For more than 50 years, SH Group has developed and delivered engineered solutions for customers operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
Today, we serve the marine, defence, energy and infrastructure sectors with solutions that support critical operations, both onshore and offshore. From handling and recovery systems to specialised mission equipment and lifecycle support, our focus is always the same: delivering reliable solutions that perform when it matters most.
Driven by curiosity, craftsmanship and a commitment to long-term partnerships, we continue to develop solutions that create value for our customers and support their success for years to come.
All key capabilities under one roof
What sets SH Group apart is our integrated approach.
Engineering, manufacturing, assembly, testing and service are all brought together under one roof, enabling close collaboration throughout the entire process.
By combining specialist expertise with in-house capabilities, we maintain control of quality, performance and delivery from concept to commissioning and beyond.
Our customers choose SH Group because we understand the realities they face. Harsh environments, complex operations and high expectations demand solutions that are robust, reliable and built to last.
From design to delivery, quality, safety and compliance remain at the core of everything we do.
pages.title: About us - Engineering expertise since 1974 | SH Group

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Our certifications support the way we work across engineering, manufacturing, installation and service. They provide a common framework for maintaining high standards, improving performance and delivering reliable solutions to our customers.
See and download our certifications here.
pages.title: Certifications - Our commitment to quality & safety | SH Group

pages.main_text_excerpt:
At SH Group, quality is an integral part of everything we do. We work systematically with quality assurance throughout the entire value chain to ensure that our products and solutions meet both customer requirements and the highest international standards.
Through documented processes, continuous improvements, and a strong quality culture, we ensure consistent results, high operational reliability, and reliable delivery.
Our employees are committed to creating value through quality, and we continuously work to optimize processes, prevent errors, and strengthen customer satisfaction. Quality at SH Group is not only about meeting requirements, but about creating trust and long-term relationships.
Working environment
Safety and well-being in focus for safe and healthy working environment is a fundamental prerequisite for our success. At SH Group, we work purposefully to create a workplace where safety, well-being and responsibility go hand in hand.
We prevent risks through systematic working environment work, ongoing training, and active involvement of employees. Our goal is to ensure that everyone returns home safely every day, while at the same time supporting a working environment characterized by respect, cooperation, and development.
We believe that strong results are created by employees who thrive, feel safe and have the opportunity to develop their skills.
Supporting a more sustainable future
Responsible production with a focus on the future. At SH Group, we take responsibility for our environmental impact and work actively to reduce our climate and environmental footprint. We integrate environmental considerations into our processes, investments, and daily decisions to contribute to a more sustainable future.
Our efforts include, among other things, efficient use of resources, reduction of waste, focus on energy consumption and continuous improvements to our environmental performance. We work closely with customers, suppliers, and employees to develop solutions that support the sustainable development of both the business and society.
We see environmental responsibility as a natural part of our company and as an important element in creating value for future generations.

pages.title: Management and organisation - SH Group | SH Group

pages.main_text_excerpt:
1974
Svendborg Hydraulik founded
Svendborg hydraulik is founded in Svendborg, Denmark.
1989-1992
The company was acquired by JAM in 1989, but following JAM's bankruptcy, Jens Nielsen and two partners acquired the company in 1992, restoring independent ownership.
1990's
The company expands its customer base and develops increasingly advanced hydraulic solutions for maritime and industrial applications.
2005
Additional engineering resources are added, strengthening the company's ability to develop customised systems and solutions.
2006
A management buyout led by Lars Præst, Morten Nielsen and Jeppe Sonne marks a significant milestone in the company's development. Shortly afterwards, Svendborg Hydraulik is renamed SH Group A/S, reflecting a broader strategic vision and increased investment in engineering and system solutions
2010
SH Group designs and delivers its first offshore A-frame, DPL 10113, marking an important step into advanced offshore handling solutions and laying the foundation for future launch and recovery systems.
2012
BWB Partners acquires SH Group, supporting the company's continued growth and international expansion.
SH Group establishes its own automation and electrical engineering department, enabling the development of integrated hydraulic, mechanical and electrical control systems in-house.
SEPRO becomes part of SH Group, adding proven A-frame designs, launch and recovery expertise, and an international customer network that strengthens the company's position within marine handling systems.
2020
SH Defence is established as a dedicated business area, and the invention of the Cube System begins.
2024
Mentha Capital acquires SH Group, supporting the company's next phase of growth and international development.
